Interactive ECB policy path and meeting-by-meeting Deposit Facility Rate (DFR) probabilities derived from 3-Month €STR Futures (`ST3`) on Eurex via Regularized Weighted Linear Least Squares (WLS) curve deaveraging.

## Implied Deposit Facility Rate Path

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px

df_curve = pd.read_csv("data/ecb_curve.csv")
df_curve["meeting_date"] = pd.to_datetime(df_curve["meeting_date"])

fig_curve = px.line(
    df_curve,
    x="meeting_date",
    y="implied_post_rate",
    markers=True,
    title="<b>Implied ECB Deposit Facility Rate Across Upcoming Meetings</b>",
    labels={
        "meeting_date": "Governing Council Meeting",
        "implied_post_rate": "Implied DFR (%)"
    },
    color_discrete_sequence=["#003399"]  # Official ECB Blue
)

fig_curve.update_traces(
    mode="lines+markers",
    marker=dict(size=8),
    hovertemplate="<b>%{x|%b %d, %Y}</b><br>Implied DFR: %{y:.3f}%<extra></extra>"
)

fig_curve.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    xaxis=dict(showgrid=True, tickformat="%b %Y"),
    yaxis=dict(showgrid=True, ticksuffix="%"),
    margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40),
    height=420
)

fig_curve.show()
```

## ECB Meeting Probabilities

```{python}
df_probs = pd.read_csv("data/ecb_probabilities.csv")

fig_probs = px.bar(
    df_probs,
    x="target_rate",
    y="probability",
    color="meeting_name",
    barmode="group",
    text="probability",
    title="<b>ECB Deposit Facility Rate Target Distributions</b>",
    labels={
        "target_rate": "DFR Target Rate",
        "probability": "Probability (%)",
        "meeting_name": "ECB Meeting"
    },
    color_discrete_sequence=px.colors.qualitative.Set2
)

fig_probs.update_traces(
    texttemplate="%{text:.1f}%",
    textposition="outside"
)

fig_probs.update_layout(
    yaxis_range=[0, 105],
    template="plotly_white",
    xaxis_title="Deposit Facility Rate Target",
    yaxis_title="Probability (%)",
    legend_title="Meeting",
    margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=60, b=40),
    height=480
)

fig_probs.show()
```

## Probability Summary Data

```{python}
pivot_table = df_probs.pivot(
    index="target_rate",
    columns="meeting_name",
    values="probability"
).fillna(0.0)

pivot_table = pivot_table.map(lambda x: f"{x:.1f}%" if x > 0 else "-")
pivot_table
```
